en.headline: National Day fireworks set for Victoria Harbour on 1 October
en.dek: A 23-minute display launching 31,888 shells will mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China under the theme Eternal Radiance.
body: The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau said a National Day fireworks display will take place over Victoria Harbour at 8pm on 1 October, lasting about 23 minutes.

The show, themed “Eternal Radiance”, will launch 31,888 pyrotechnic shells from nine firing points on three barges and six floating pontoons. It is estimated to cost about HK$18 million and is exclusively sponsored by Sun Life Hong Kong.

The display is divided into eight scenes and will celebrate the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China. Synchronised music will be broadcast on RTHK Radio 4. Viewing points include Tsim Sha Tsui, Hung Hom and other harbourfront areas.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演10月1日維港上演
zh.dek: 約23分鐘匯演將燃放31,888枚煙花，主題「永明煙花 綻放中華」，慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局表示，國慶煙花匯演將於10月1日晚上8時在維多利亞港上空舉行，歷時約23分鐘。
匯演以「永明煙花 綻放中華」為主題，由三艘躉船及六艘小浮船在九個發放點燃放31,888枚煙花，估計費用約1,800萬元，由香港永明金融獨家贊助。
匯演共分八幕，慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年。香港電台第四台將同步播放背景音樂，市民可於尖沙咀、紅磡等海旁觀賞。
